newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian shares up on local demand, look to U.S..
newsitem.headline: Russian shares up on local demand, look to U.S..

text.p: Russian shares rose through early afternoon, pushing the RTS shares index close to the 500 point level and traders said domestic operators counting on a flood of orders from the West were the primary buyers.
Prospekt equities chief Andrei Ippolitov said a rise in the U.S. Dow Jones had also spurred buying in Russia.
"All this is happening in the first half of the day and New York is quite capable of correcting it," he said. But the Dow Jones surged 104 points in early trade to a record 7,962.
Traders said the forthcoming auction for 38 percent of metals giant Norilsk Nickel pushed its prices higher.
Norilsk Nickel ordinaries soared to $13.50 at 1220 GMT, up from $11.37 at Tuesday's close, Norilsk preferred shares rose to $11.00 from $9.20.
Bids for the auction are accepted from July 22 to August 1. Results will be announced on August 5.
Rostelekom telecoms company ordinaries rose to $3.93 from $4.87, UES rose to $0.4613 from $0.4610.
